shared_floor_audit.notes: The source calls (2.2.14) and (2.2.15) equivalent, but the current ASTIS interfaces intentionally model them separately. On a bare linear map, the mixed Gamma chain rule and the second-order generator chain rule cannot be converted by a one-line ring rearrangement: the textbook verification uses scalar functional calculus / perturbation regularity that is not represented in the current domain contract. Until this bridge is formalized, downstream cells may expose one formulation as a separate parent contract, but a source-minimal Theorem 8.3.1 node may not silently assume both as independent hypotheses.

blocked.reason: The current #219/#221 abstractions sit over a bare LinearMap plus observable-domain closure. A faithful equivalence proof needs an additional scalar functional-calculus / perturbation regularity contract (or a stronger canonical diffusion-operator object) before the textbook Exercise 2.8 argument can be represented without circularly assuming the target identity.
